goal: Harden the PRA-10 ground-truth validation so it cannot pass vacuously: (1) re-apply the reviewed-in-blindspot writer-persistence check (the writer's session file must exist in the writer's own live save_path) and live save_path normalisation (strip 0;/N;MODE; prefixes and trailing slashes, refuse depth N>0 or empty paths); (2) assert every expected two-pool scenario (fpm-shared-store-mismatch, fpm-isolated-stores, fpm-shared-store-same-serializer) was validated against ground truth at least once, and fail loudly on a two-pool scenario whose pools are not writer/reader; (3) record the reader's session_start error and treat 'cannot decode' as ground truth only when PHP reports a session decode failure, rejecting any other reader failure on a shared store as unusable ground truth; (4) fix the unwrapped README line.
